did: Home now pushes live game state to the paired phone over its game-week socket (#824): I rebased it after ESPN's live situation landed and raised the contract epoch to 4. I built the bite matcher (#832): every ten minutes it matches each voice bite of a finished game to the nearest play its scenario accepts, within 90 seconds before the bite, and keeps every other bite marked with why it went unmatched. Nothing is rewritten; matches and mappings are append-only. An independent review found no blocking bug; I fixed four of its risks (late bites, a game that left the week, new mappings, one failing game blocking a pass) and listed the rest on the pull request.

calls.title: Where the bite matcher runs
options: its own task on home, every 10 minutes
calls.why: Running it in the game feed's worker would break that worker's written invariant (GF4); you said to go with the recommended (C160).
calls.undo: Move reconcile::start's pass into the game feed's worker, and amend GF4 in game-feed.md.
